name: ephemeral-k8s-test-envs
description: Per-pull-request ephemeral test environments on Kubernetes.
author: AKogut

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix app/auth-service install && npm --prefix app/notes-service install && npm --prefix app/gateway install && npm --prefix scripts install && PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1 npm --prefix tests/api install
scripts.build: npm --prefix app/auth-service run build && npm --prefix app/notes-service run build && npm --prefix app/gateway run build && npm --prefix scripts run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix app/auth-service run typecheck && npm --prefix app/notes-service run typecheck && npm --prefix app/gateway run typecheck && npm --prefix scripts run typecheck && npm --prefix tests/api run typecheck
scripts.helm:lint: helm lint charts/test-env && helm lint charts/test-env -f charts/test-env/values-ci.yaml
scripts.helm:template: helm template preview charts/test-env --namespace preview -f charts/test-env/values-ci.yaml
scripts.compose:test: mkdir -p results && chmod a+rwX results && docker compose --profile test run --rm api-tests
scripts.ci:install: npm --prefix app/auth-service ci && npm --prefix app/notes-service ci && npm --prefix app/gateway ci && npm --prefix scripts ci && PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1 npm --prefix tests/api ci
